DECISION 2 (this task) -- READ BEFORE USING window_summary AS A STUDY EPISODE: WindowAccumulator is classified as E_t (E_t = h(X_core, dX_core, C_t), and windowed avg/peak/variance is exactly that: a function of X_core over time). BUT 'episode' has a specific meaning in the D0PA1 study -- a trial in a controlled task environment -- and that environment DOES NOT YET EXIST (blocked on the client's D2 decision; see CLAUDE.md's BLOCKED section). The rolling window this class produces is an AGGREGATION WINDOW, not a study episode.

episode_unit for every feature below: "rolling_10s_window" (WINDOW_SECONDS, features/geometry.py). This is NOT stamped into the runtime window_summary dict itself -- adding a field there would change window_summary's JSON schema and break the byte-exact G5 regression net in tests/test_refactor_snapshot.py. The disclosure lives HERE and in docs/D1_DEPENDENCY_MAP.md instead.
When the study's real episode definition is defined (post-D2), it may differ from this window -- this manifest must be revised (bump manifest_version) when that happens, not silently reinterpreted.
